class.name: CookTrace
class.brief_description: Records the paths that the process reads while a trace is active.
class.description: Between [method begin] and [method end], the engine records each path that [FileAccess] opens for reading, each path that [method FileAccess.file_exists] checks, each directory that [DirAccess] opens and each path that [ResourceLoader] loads, including cache hits. A build step uses the list as the exact set of its input files.

method.name: begin
method.description: Clears the recorded paths and starts the trace.

method.name: end
method.description: Stops the trace and returns the recorded paths, sorted.

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Returns the paths recorded so far, sorted, and keeps the trace active.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a trace is active.
